headlines.title: UK risks being 'uninvestable' if new oil and gas fields not approved, warns oil giant
headlines.description: Equinor warns it may shun further investments in the UK if new oil and gas fields at Rosebank and Jackdaw are not approved.

headlines.title: Paramount takes over Warner Bros in $110bn Hollywood merger
headlines.description: The merger of two of Hollywood's biggest movie studios comes after months of legal disputes and concern over competition.

headlines.title: Pentagon stops using Anthropic AI tools after blacklisting company, BBC told
headlines.description: It labelled Anthropic a "supply chain risk" in February after the firm refused to remove safety guardrails from its tools.

headlines.title: Average five-year mortgage rate hits 6% for first time in three years
headlines.description: The cost of a new fixed-rate mortgage has been rising in recent weeks as lenders face higher costs.

headlines.title: BT agrees rescue deal to buy broadband operator TalkTalk
headlines.description: The takeover still needs to be approved by the regulator, but would give certainty to TalkTalk's millions of customers
